content:
Hexagonal architecture (binding for all CUs in this feature).

ARCH.LAYERS: domain > application > infrastructure > control. Dependency direction is strictly inward: domain imports nothing from outer layers; application may import domain only; infrastructure implements domain ports; control wires everything via dependency-injector containers.
ARCH.PORTS: outbound ports to inbound adapters. Kafka, LiteLLM, Spark/lakehouse access crosses a Protocol port defined in src/domain/interfaces.py (KafkaPort, AIPort, StoragePort). Never import infrastructure modules from domain or application code.
ARCH.DI: containers live in src/control/dependency_layers.py. BasePlatformContainer holds config + logger_provider; DiscoveryContainer and IngestionContainer extend it. Provider references to BasePlatformContainer.config propagate to child instances (verified) — keep that pattern, do not rewire.
ARCH.LOGGING: structlog filtering bound logger, key-value event style (logger.info("event_name", key=value)). No printf-style positional args in new/edited log calls.
ARCH.SEVERITY: CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR/TRIVIAL per coder contract. CRITICAL = data loss, silent drops, infinite loops, unhandled poison pills — hard fail, stop and escalate.
ARCH.STOP: each CU ends with an explicit stop condition; anything outside the CU's file list belongs to another CU.

LEGEND for feat-1 ITR frames.

CU-ID: arch = shared architecture context (this file). legend = this legend. cu-001..cu-008 = regular implementation units, zero-padded sequence numbers.
DTR-COORDINATES use MOD.<repo-relative-module-path> style (no baseline .dtr exists yet in .LLMDD/DTRS; coordinates are documentation + traceability keys). A coordinate naming a non-existent symbol means the CU creates it.
Frame header keys: CU-ID, CU-TYPE (ArchCU/LegendCU/RegularCU), TIMESTAMP, DTR-COORDINATES.
Feature spec: .LLMDD/spec-driven/features/feat-1-repair-startup-and-ingestion-pipeline.md. Status flow: Proposed -> In Progress -> Implemented.
Retry: coders retry a failing verification until MAX_ATTEMPTS from root SYNOPSIS.itr, then set STATUS=ESCALATED with ESCALATION_REASON/DETAIL (never silently skip).
Feedback: per-CU <app>.feedback/cu-<id>.feedback.txt inside the ITR folder (gitignored runtime state).

REQUIREMENTS
Unblock application startup: `control.main:main` currently raises ValueError/FileNotFound because input_files/ (seed_urls.json, traversal_policies.json, relevance_policies.json) is missing and git-ignored, and no .env.example exists. This CU ships tracked sample configs plus env template so a fresh checkout plus documented copy steps reaches config build. This CU touches repo root and input_files/ only — no Python code.
COORDINATES
MOD.input_files.seed_urls(.example).json (creates), MOD.input_files.traversal_policies(.example).json (creates), MOD.input_files.relevance_policies(.example).json (creates), MOD.dot-env-example (creates), MOD.dot-gitignore (edits negation lines only).
IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS
1. Create input_files/seed_urls.example.json exactly: {"include": ["en"], "exclude": [], "en": ["https://example.com/news"]}. Schema contract from src/control/main.py::_get_seed_urls: top-level "include"/"exclude" language lists plus <lang> -> [urls] mappings; only included, non-excluded languages are crawled. Do NOT touch main.py.
2. Create input_files/traversal_policies.example.json as a one-element list, last-active-wins per _get_active_config (filters dicts with "active" is True, takes last): [{"active": true, "query": "latest news articles", "required_path_segments": [], "blocked_path_segments": ["login", "signup", "cart", "checkout"], "max_depth": 2}]. Field contract from domain.models.TraversalRules plus the container's config.policy.traversal.query usage. Do NOT add a query field to the TraversalRules model (out of scope, cu-005 area).
3. Create input_files/relevance_policies.example.json as a one-element list: [{"active": true, "name": "news-v1", "description": "News article content about current events, politics, technology, science or the economy. Navigation chrome, ads, cookie banners and login walls are NOT relevant.", "include_terms": ["news", "report", "article", "government", "technology", "science", "economy", "election", "climate"], "exclude_terms": ["<html", "stylesheet", "cookie consent", "subscribe to continue"]}]. Field contract from domain.models.RelevancePolicy.
4. Create working copies input_files/seed_urls.json, traversal_policies.json, relevance_policies.json (byte-identical to the .example files) so this checkout runs. Do NOT rename main.py's expected filenames.
5. Create .env.example with keys read in src/control/main.py: LITELLM_API_KEY, PHOENIX_COLLECTOR_ENDPOINT, PHOENIX_API_KEY, MINIO_ACCESS_KEY, MINIO_SECRET_KEY, HOST_IP, LOCAL_SPARK_MODE. Placeholder values only, never real secrets.
6. Edit .gitignore minimally: under the `**/input_files/**` line add `!**/input_files/*.example.json`; under `*.*env*` add `!.env.example`. Do NOT remove any existing ignore line.
7. Prove: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -c "from pathlib import Path; from control.main import _get_seed_urls, _get_active_config; s=_get_seed_urls(Path('input_files/seed_urls.json')); t=_get_active_config(Path('input_files/traversal_policies.json')); r=_get_active_config(Path('input_files/relevance_policies.json')); print(s, t['max_depth'], r['name'])" — expect `{'en': ['https://example.com/news']} 2 news-v1`. Stop when this prints; Python source fixes belong to cu-002..cu-007.
ACCEPTANCE
A1 [feat-1 criterion 1]: the prove command in step 7 prints the expected line. COMMAND: same as step 7. EXPECTED: exit 0 + expected output.
A2: `git status --short` shows input_files/*.example.json and .env.example as untracked-but-addable (not ignored). COMMAND: `git check-ignore input_files/seed_urls.example.json .env.example; echo $?`. EXPECTED: exit 1 (nothing ignored).

REQUIREMENTS
Fix the ingestion write path in src/domain/services/data_ingestion.py: (a) the buffer is keyed by chunk_id, which is unique per chunk (f"{url}::{idx}" in scraper.py), so `len(group) >= buffer_size (5)` can never trigger and zero records ever reach the lakehouse; (b) bare `case _: raise` re-raises with no active exception (RuntimeError) on record-creation failure; (c) the `did_it_flush == 0` branch logs logger.error for the normal buffered state. Regroup buffering by source_url, add flush_all for shutdown tails, make failure matches exhaustive, demote the buffered log to debug. Touch ONLY src/domain/services/data_ingestion.py.
COORDINATES
MOD.src.domain.services.data_ingestion.IngestionPipeline (edits ingest_if_relevant, _check_and_flush_group, _flush_group; creates flush_all).
IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS
1. In ingest_if_relevant, replace `self._buffer.setdefault(bronzerecord.chunk_id, []).append(bronzerecord)` and the following `_check_and_flush_group(bronzerecord.chunk_id, log)` call with grouping by `group_key: str = bronzerecord.source_url`. Keep the surrounding match structure; keep buffer_size semantics (flush when a group reaches buffer_size).
2. Replace `case _: raise` with two explicit arms: `case IOSuccess(Failure(e))` (log "Failed to create bronze record" + `raise e`) and `case IOFailure(Failure(e))` (log + `raise e`). IOSuccess/Success and IOFailure are already imported in the module — do NOT add imports.
3. In _check_and_flush_group add the missing `case IOSuccess(Failure(error)): raise error` arm. In _flush_group add the same missing arm and delete the trailing unreachable `return 0` after the match.
4. Add `@future_safe async def flush_all(self) -> int` that iterates list(self._buffer.keys()), awaits _flush_group per key with self.logger, sums counts, and re-raises on IOSuccess(Failure)/IOFailure(Failure) arms. Place after _check_and_flush_group.
5. Change the `else: self.logger.error("Record buffer is empty.")` branch to self.logger.debug("Record buffered, awaiting flush threshold.").
6. Prove: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q src (exit 0), then run the ephemeral check: feed 5 same-source relevant chunks through IngestionPipeline with fake AIPort (is_relevant -> True) and fake StoragePort, buffer_size=5 — expect 5 written; feed 1 other-source chunk — expect still 5; await flush_all() — expect 6 total. Stop when green; Kafka/service-loop behavior belongs to cu-003/cu-004, Spark I/O to cu-006.
ACCEPTANCE
A3 [feat-1 criterion 2]: five same-source chunks yield exactly 5 lakehouse writes; flush_all writes the tail. COMMAND: ephemeral script from step 6 (paste into `PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -c`, fakes inline). EXPECTED: counts 5 then 6, exit 0.
A4 [feat-1 criterion 3]: forced _create_record failure raises the original error, never "No active exception to reraise". COMMAND: same harness with a record missing source_url. EXPECTED: raised error mentions the missing key, not bare-raise RuntimeError.

REQUIREMENTS
Fix the discovery consumer loop in src/application/services/discovery_service.py: (a) the quiescent branch (idle_polls >= IDLE_THRESHOLD with no active tasks) awaits wait_for_tasks then `continue`s forever — the thread never terminates; break instead. (b) log calls slice raw bytes (`record.value[:100]`) inside printf-style structlog args; switch to a decoded _preview helper with key-value logging. (c) add missing IOSuccess(Failure) arms. Touch ONLY src/application/services/discovery_service.py.
COORDINATES
MOD.src.application.services.discovery_service.DiscoveryService (edits run loop tail, per-record handling; creates _preview).
IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS
1. In run(), inside the `if idle_polls >= IDLE_THRESHOLD:` block after `await self.wait_for_tasks()`, add `break` so the loop exits when quiescent with zero in-flight tasks. The outer `continue` stays for the below-threshold idle path. Do NOT change IDLE_THRESHOLD (10), timeout_ms (1000), or max_records (5).
2. Replace the per-record match body: compute `preview: str = self._preview(record.value)` once, then three arms — IOSuccess(Success(_)) -> self.logger.info("Record passed to discovery queue.", record_preview=preview); IOSuccess(Failure(e)) -> error log with record_preview + error=str(e); IOFailure(Failure(e)) -> error log likewise. Delete the `assert record.value` lines and printf-style `record.value[:100]` args.
3. Add `@staticmethod def _preview(value: bytes | None, limit: int = 100) -> str` returning "<empty>" for None else value.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:limit]. Place directly after _safe_decode.
4. Prove: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q src (exit 0) and `PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -c "import inspect; from application.services.discovery_service import DiscoveryService; s=inspect.getsource(DiscoveryService.run); assert s.count('break')>=1; print('break OK')"`. Stop when green; ingestion-side handling is cu-004, scraper internals cu-005.
ACCEPTANCE
A5 [feat-1 criterion 4]: run() source contains a loop exit on the quiescent path. COMMAND: step-4 inline check. EXPECTED: prints `break OK`, exit 0.
A6: no `record.value[:100]` printf-style log args remain in the module. COMMAND: `rg -n 'value\[:100\]' src/application/services/discovery_service.py; echo $?`. EXPECTED: exit 1 (no matches).

REQUIREMENTS
Fix ingestion consumer handling in src/application/services/ingestion_service.py: (a) `data["source_url"]` in the Chunk-written log raises KeyError on malformed payloads — use .get; (b) decode failures and pipeline failures have no match arms, so poison-pill records are retried forever without commit — log + commit the offset to skip; (c) commit-failure arm missing for IOSuccess(Failure). Touch ONLY src/application/services/ingestion_service.py.
COORDINATES
MOD.src.application.services.ingestion_service.IngestionService (edits _handle_ingestion only).
IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS
1. Change `self.logger.info("Chunk written", url=data["source_url"])` to `url=data.get("source_url")`.
2. In the commit-result match, add `case IOSuccess(Failure(exception))` logging "Chunk commit failed" with url=data.get("source_url"). Keep the existing IOFailure arm.
3. After the `case IOSuccess(Success(data)):` block, add `case IOSuccess(Failure(exception)):` logging "Skipping undecodable record" then `await self.kafka_consumer.commit({tp: record.offset}).awaitable()`, and `case IOFailure(Failure(exception)):` logging "Record decode IO failure" then committing likewise. This preserves at-least-once progress on poison pills. Do NOT change subscribe topics (["relevant_chunks"]), getmany args, or the success-path commit.
4. Prove: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q src (exit 0) plus a fake-KafkaPort harness: feed one undecodable record then one good record; expect the good record still processed and both offsets committed. Stop when green; pipeline internals are cu-002.
ACCEPTANCE
A7 [feat-1 criterion 5]: poison-pill record is skipped via commit and the next record processes. COMMAND: ephemeral fake-consumer harness from step 4. EXPECTED: exit 0, both offsets committed, good record reaches the pipeline.
A8: no `data["source_url"]` subscript remains in the module. COMMAND: `rg -n 'data\["source_url"\]' src/application/services/ingestion_service.py; echo $?`. EXPECTED: exit 1 (no matches).

REQUIREMENTS
Harden the crawler in src/domain/services/scraper.py and its port in src/domain/interfaces.py: (a) initialize_and_seed and _publish_chunks matches miss the IOSuccess(Failure) case — silent swallows / bogus RuntimeError; (b) strategy.chunk receives StringCompatibleMarkdown where str is expected — coerce with str(); (c) the CrawlerResult protocol lacks `url` although deep_crawl reads result.url and the real crawl4ai CrawlResult exposes it. Touch ONLY these two files.
COORDINATES
MOD.src.domain.services.scraper.StreamScraper (edits initialize_and_seed, _publish_chunks), MOD.src.domain.interfaces.CrawlerResult (adds url: str).
IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS
1. interfaces.py: in CrawlerResult add `url: str` after the markdown line. Do NOT touch any other Protocol.
2. scraper.py initialize_and_seed: in the send_result match add `case IOSuccess(Failure(e))` (log seed=url, error=str(e), raise e) alongside the existing IOFailure arm; change existing `error=e` to `error=str(e)`. Add `case IOSuccess(Failure(e)): raise e` before the existing IOFailure arm of the infra_res match; keep the final `case _: raise RuntimeError("Kafka initialization inconsistent")`. Do NOT change topics, payload shape, or traversal gating.
3. scraper.py _publish_chunks: change `self.strategy.chunk(content)` to `self.strategy.chunk(str(content))`; extend the send_res match with `case IOSuccess(Failure(e))` logging chunk_publish_failed like the IOFailure arm.
4. Prove: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q src (exit 0) and `PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -c "from domain.interfaces import CrawlerResult; print('url' in CrawlerResult.__annotations__)"` prints True. Stop when green; consumer loops are cu-003/cu-004.
ACCEPTANCE
A9: CrawlerResult protocol exposes url. COMMAND: step-4 inline check. EXPECTED: prints True.
A10: every `match send_res` / `match send_result` / `match infra_res` in scraper.py has IOSuccess(Failure) coverage. COMMAND: `rg -n 'IOSuccess\(Failure' src/domain/services/scraper.py`. EXPECTED: >= 3 matches.

REQUIREMENTS
Fix two data-layer defects: (a) LinguisticService.generate_semantic_records in src/domain/services/linguistic_model.py passes non-existent control_action/gram_type kwargs to BronzeRecord (silently dropped by pydantic) — remove them; (b) LakehouseConnector._convert_embedding in src/infrastructure/lakehouse.py pattern-matches `value in [None, Never]` (comparison against the typing.Never object, and Maybe unwrap mishandled) — rewrite with explicit Nothing check + unwrap. Touch ONLY these two files.
COORDINATES
MOD.src.domain.services.linguistic_model.LinguisticService (edits generate_semantic_records), MOD.src.infrastructure.lakehouse.LakehouseConnector (edits _convert_embedding + imports).
IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS
1. linguistic_model.py: delete the `control_action="NONE",` and `gram_type="GM3"` kwargs from the BronzeRecord(...) construction. Keep chunk_id/source_url/content/language/embedding=Some(vector). Do NOT add new model fields.
2. lakehouse.py imports: replace `from returns.maybe import Maybe` with `from returns.maybe import Maybe, Nothing`; replace `from typing import Never, Final` with `from typing import Final`.
3. lakehouse.py: replace the whole _convert_embedding match block with: `if embedding is Nothing or embedding == Nothing: return None`; try `value = embedding.unwrap()` except (AttributeError, ValueError, TypeError) -> None; `if value is None: return None`; try assert isinstance(value, list) + float coercion except (TypeError, ValueError, AssertionError) -> None. Keep the method signature.
4. Prove: compileall exit 0; `PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -c "from infrastructure.lakehouse import LakehouseConnector; c=LakehouseConnector.__new__(LakehouseConnector); from returns.maybe import Nothing, Some; assert c._convert_embedding(Nothing) is None; assert c._convert_embedding(Some([1, 2.5]))==[1.0, 2.5]; print('LAKEHOUSE OK')"`; and generate_semantic_records with a fake ai_provider returns BronzeRecords without TypeError. Stop when green; Spark session wiring untouched.
ACCEPTANCE
A11: Maybe-conversion probe prints LAKEHOUSE OK. COMMAND: step-4 inline check. EXPECTED: exit 0 + LAKEHOUSE OK.
A12: `rg -n 'control_action|gram_type' src/domain/services/linguistic_model.py` is empty and `rg -n 'Never' src/infrastructure/lakehouse.py` is empty. COMMAND: both rg calls. EXPECTED: exit 1 each (no matches).

REQUIREMENTS
Fix three wiring/paper-cut defects: (a) notebooks/python/silver_layer.py (and its paired .ipynb cell) imports non-existent DataPlatformContainer — alias BasePlatformContainer; (b) pyproject.toml depends on the `dotenv` shim instead of `python-dotenv` — swap + relock; (c) LitellmClient.is_relevant uses max_tokens 5, which risks truncating the 'NOT RELEVANT' verdict — raise to 10. Touch ONLY notebooks/python/silver_layer.py, notebooks/python/silver_layer.ipynb (one cell), pyproject.toml (+uv.lock via `uv lock`), src/infrastructure/litellm_client.py.
COORDINATES
MOD.notebooks.silver_layer (edits import), MOD.pyproject (edits dotenv dep), MOD.src.infrastructure.litellm_client.LitellmClient (edits max_tokens).
IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS
1. silver_layer.py: replace `from src.control.dependency_layers import DataPlatformContainer` with `from src.control.dependency_layers import BasePlatformContainer as DataPlatformContainer`. Apply the identical replacement to the matching cell source in silver_layer.ipynb via a JSON edit script (json.load, str.replace on the cell, json.dump indent=1) — do NOT reformat other cells.
2. pyproject.toml: replace the `"dotenv",` dependency line with `"python-dotenv",`, then run `uv lock` from repo root (expect `Removed dotenv vX` in output). Do NOT touch any other dependency or the entry point.
3. litellm_client.py is_relevant payload: `"max_tokens": 5` -> `"max_tokens": 10`. Do NOT touch prompt text, temperature, or endpoint logic.
4. Prove: compileall exit 0; `PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -c "from src.control.dependency_layers import BasePlatformContainer as DataPlatformContainer; print('NOTEBOOK IMPORT OK')"`; `uv lock --check` (or lock freshness) passes. Stop when green; docs are cu-008.
ACCEPTANCE
A13: notebook import alias resolves. COMMAND: step-4 inline check. EXPECTED: prints NOTEBOOK IMPORT OK.
A14: `rg -n '"dotenv"' pyproject.toml` empty and uv.lock has no `name = "dotenv"` package entry. COMMAND: both rg calls (second: `rg -n 'name = "dotenv"' uv.lock; echo $?`). EXPECTED: exit 1 each.

REQUIREMENTS
Replace the placeholder README.md (32 lines, infra links + ASCII diagram only) with a decent operator-grade README: what NewsPipe is, ASCII pipeline diagram (keep the existing one), prerequisites/services, install (uv sync, newspipe-ingest entry point + PYTHONPATH fallback), configuration (.env table + input_files schemas for seed_urls/traversal/relevance with the copy-commands from cu-001), run, notebooks/silver-layer overview, hexagonal layout map (domain/application/infrastructure/control + dependency rule), troubleshooting section mapping each failure to its fix. Depends on cu-001..cu-007 being implemented first (docs must describe the fixed behavior: source_url grouping + flush_all, quiescent exit, .example.json copies). Touch ONLY README.md.
COORDINATES
MOD.readme (rewrites README.md).
IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS
1. Write README.md (~150-220 lines, no emojis): sections — title+intro, pipeline diagram, prerequisites (Python 3.12, uv, Kafka/MinIO/LiteLLM/Spark/Phoenix), install, configuration (.env table incl. LOCAL_SPARK_MODE; input_files schemas + the three `cp ...example.json` commands), run (`uv run newspipe-ingest`), notebooks/silver layer temp-view chain, layout map, troubleshooting (missing input_files, missing lakehouse config, empty lakehouse -> policy/buffer notes, quiescent exit, S3A jars). Keep it factual; do NOT document infra provisioning (lives in the pipeline_infra repo).
2. Prove: `wc -l README.md` >= 100 and `rg -c '^#{1,3} ' README.md` >= 6 (real sections), plus a self-review pass that every input_files filename and env var named in the README exists in code (main.py) or cu-001 samples. Stop when done; this is the final CU, no code changes allowed here.
ACCEPTANCE
A15 [feat-1 criterion 7]: README has >= 6 sections, >= 100 lines, and names only real config keys/files. COMMAND: step-2 checks. EXPECTED: both numeric checks pass; manual key-vs-code spot check clean.
